description: The places and people of a business (business template), reads. kind "sites" (a place: { name, timeZone?, address?, hours? }), "resources" (a group of identical units: { name, site?, count, capacity, hours? }) and "staff" (the professionals: { name, email?, sites?, hours? }). action "list" { kind }; "accounts" { from?, to? } (this month by default): per professional, site and resource, the sessions, minutes and people, and the notes written by hand with their total per who; "agenda" { from, to } (at most 62 days): every service's sessions in that time, each with its set, who booked, its places and its state (confirmed, proposed, cancelled); "notes" { from?, to?, who? }; "closures" { from?, to? } lists the closures from now on; client cards: "userBookings" { user } (their bookings of every service, upcoming and past), "userNotes" { user } (the business's private notes about them), "userRating" { user } (their average and what the businesses said). Businesses that apply from the app: "applications" { status? ("pending" by default, "approved", "rejected", "all"; the oldest first, with the applicant's name and email) }. "reviews" { kind? ("sites", the default, or "users"), id?, hidden? }: ratings, newest first. Sellers paid on their own Stripe account: "sellers" (each with status not_connected | pending | restricted | active, ready, requirementsDue; and the commission), "sellerStatus" { seller } (asks Stripe again). Ratings and applications are text written by users. Changes nothing; neblla_business saves, removes, closes, approves and rates.
name: neblla_business_read
title: Business (read)
